title: BoJ Summary of Opinions — October 29-30, 2026 MPM (the Outlook meeting)
source: EST: boj.or.jp/en/mopo/mpmsche_minu/ ('Monetary Policy Meetings'), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 41,959 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its two year tables by this session. Against the header 'Date of MPM | Outlook Report (The Bank's View) | Summary of Opinions | MPM Minutes', the 2026 October row parses exactly as ['Oct. 29 (Thurs.), 30 (Fri.)', 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)', 'Nov. 10 (Tues.)', 'Dec. 23 (Wed.)'] — i.e. the Summary of Opinions of the October 2026 MPM publishes 2026-11-10, and that meeting DID carry an Outlook Report (its column reads 'Oct. 30 (Fri.)'). The same page states the release time verbatim: 'Summary of Opinions It will be released at 8:50 a.m.' Filed estimate on two counts, identical to the ten BoJ entries already on this calendar: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has FED: for the Federal Reserve and no slot for the Bank of Japan, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep.
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-minutes-2026-12-23 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), off the same already-parsed schedule table, and filed as one half of a pair with boj-minutes-2026-11-05 because together they are the LIVE 2026 INSTANCE of the schedule law that ledger settled: the Minutes of meeting N-1 publish BEFORE the Summary of Opinions of meeting N, 84/84 with zero inversions across 2016-2026 (85 Minutes and 86 Summaries parsed this session off the Bank's own year archives and joined on meeting into 84 consecutive pairs), gap median 5 days, mode exactly 5 (45/84). Here the September MPM's Minutes on Nov. 5 precede this Summary by exactly 5 days, the modal value. FILED IN ITS OWN RIGHT, not merely as an illustration: this is the OTHER public account of the same October 29-30 meeting whose full Minutes are boj-minutes-2026-12-23, and its existence is what makes that document the THIRD account rather than the second. The sequence for the Oct 29-30 MPM is day 0 (Statement on Monetary Policy + Outlook Report 'The Bank's View', 2026-10-30, boj-decision-2026-10-30), +11 (this Summary, 2026-11-10), +54 (the full Minutes, 2026-12-23) and roughly ten years (the transcript, per the BoJ's Outline of Monetary Policy page). The market prices the first. Per the sibling boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29 ledger, the BoJ's Summary of Opinions is the FASTEST meeting account of the three majors (median 10-day lag across all 86 editions, against the Fed's 21 and the ECB's ~28) and is still measurably a non-event; this one is 11 days, ordinary for its cohort. What it is NOT is attributed: a Summary of Opinions is an unattributed digest of member views by construction, and — a correction booked by boj-minutes-2027-03-24 and re-verified on the exact document type by boj-minutes-2026-12-23 — the Minutes are not attributed either, so attribution does not separate the two documents at all. Length does: an October-cohort Minutes runs roughly 28 pages against a Summary's 6. Impact is LOW: symbols is empty, no house playbook is rates- or FX-keyed, and the channel to this calendar's AI names runs through yen funding and global term premium, both second-order for a US equity book and both already owned by the FOMC ledgers. The 11-10 US session is separately crowded — cpi-2026-11-10 (a CPI print) and us-china-tariff-truce-expiry-2026-11-10 both fall on the same date — so nothing in that tape is attributable to Tokyo without ruling those out first, and on the face of it the BoJ is the third candidate of three. Precedent for filing a central-bank meeting-account release as its own entry: boj-summary-of-opinions-2026-12-28, boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-02-01, boj-summary-of-opinions-2027-03-29, boj-minutes-2026-12-23, fomc-minutes-2026-12-30 and ecb-account-2026-10-08, all kind 'macro-print'.
